name: Student Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Non-belongers must obtain a Student Permit to study in Anguilla.
Requires a letter of acceptance from the educational institution.
Must demonstrate financial ability to support oneself and any dependants.
Requires a police reference covering the 5 years prior to application, plus two character references from non-family members.

evidence_required.document: Health insurance documentation with coverage dates
Letter of acceptance from educational institution
Colour passport photo and passport copy

sources.title: Government of Anguilla -- Higher Education Licensing Board: Student Permit and Student Work Permit process, eligibility, documents, and fees

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Anguilla's initial build. work_rights set to 'restricted': permit holders may do unpaid work related to their studies without further permission, but paid work requires a separate Student Work Permit (via the Higher Education Licensing Board) that is capped at the same expiry date as the underlying Student Permit -- not modelled as its own route since it is entirely derivative of this one. Renewability beyond the stated 3-year maximum is not addressed in the source, so renewable is conservatively false rather than guessed. family_can_join is conservatively false: the source does not address dependants accompanying a student, only that the student must show ability to support 'oneself and dependants' financially, which does not confirm a right for dependants to be included on the permit itself.
